title: The Dive Spot

services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Dive into a week of fun and learning at our STEAM Summer Camp! Campers will explore Science, Technology, Engineering, Art, and Math through exciting water-based fexperiments, creative projects, and hands-on challenges-all while staying cool in the pool. Perfect for curious kids who love to splash and explore! Train like a lifeguard and build real water safety skills! Campers will learn rescue techniques, CPR basics, teamwork, and pool safety-all while having fun in the sun. Perfect for confident swimmers who want to lead, learn, and maybe be a future

services.name: Swim Lessons
services.desc: Weekly Swim Lessons will begin June 5th and run in two-week long sessions all summer. We organize classes averaging 3-6 children by age and swim level, session dates, and time of day. There is a short break between classes. StarBabies and StarTots course introduces infants and toddlers to the water in a fun and loving environment. Parents or caregivers are taught the proper techniques to teach their infants and toddlers how to float, submerge, move in the water and roll over. Classes incorporate songs and activities to meet the swim skill benchmarks. Safety skill benchmarks are designed to educate the parents or caregivers. The Swim School courses for pre-school, youth and adult students
